rules.text: Reasonable: I am pleased to advise you that this property is believed to be a reasonable proposition for purchase at {OO_PRICE}.
pdf: Reasonable: I am pleased to advise you that this property is believed to be a reasonable proposition for purchase at £390,500.00 [Three Hundred Ninety Thousand and five hundred Pounds].

rules.text: In my opinion, the property represents a {OO_RATING} proposition for purchase at the agreed price, subject to the findings and recommendations contained within this report. Future maintenance and repair should be anticipated in accordance with the property's age, construction, and level of ongoing maintenance.
pdf: In my opinion, the property represents a reasonable, good, fair, poor proposition for purchase at the agreed price, subject to the findings and recommendations contained within this report.

rules.text: Reasonable with repair: This property is believed to be a reasonable proposition for purchase, given that you are prepared to cover the costs and accept the inconvenience of dealing with any repairs or improvement works reported. These defects are considered normal in properties of this age and construction. Provided that the works are carried out to a good standard, I cannot foresee any problems regarding a future resale of the property in normal market conditions.
